hold_reason: Handoff from Alpha Co (W2) reports refunds 192 (3148c), 193 (9581c), and 194 (5972c) as applied, but list_refunds returns an empty list. The shared ledger does not reflect these refunds, so net balances may be overstated. Holding payouts until Alpha's refund application is confirmed.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to check Alpha's refund work against the ledger. I'll start by listing the refunds to confirm they match the handoff.
